lessons: Review failed only on criterion 1: tests/unit/test_loop_helpers.py has no check that the hub still resolves `until` and `turn`. Everything else (the move, the 20 import-line edits, the GitFake/FakeExec rewrites, the notify-sink branch) passed review. Don't redo it.

Append one test to tests/unit/test_loop_helpers.py: `from tests.integration import serve_rig`, then assert `serve_rig.turn is fakes.turn` and `callable(serve_rig.until)`. This is criterion 1's last clause.

In the same test, assert that each moved name on the hub is the shared object, e.g. `serve_rig.graph is loop_helpers.graph`, for graph, admission_graph, admission_config, enable_upgrade, notify_command, terminals and UpgradeChild. This is the reviewer's suggested fix.

Add the test without reading a repo file and without starting a process. Importing serve_rig only defines module attributes. Then rerun `./dev.py test tests/unit/test_loop_helpers.py` and `./dev.py test tests/unit`, and keep the base and candidate counts of 297 passed / 3341 skipped in run.md.
